findings.text: `Servex/agents/page_tools.js` is rewritten outside this task's own declared fence. The requirements.md Fences section lists only `core/Task/`, `core/Session/` ("only what this needs"), `Server/PromptRecords.mjs`, `Servex/agents/PromptTasks.js` and the migration script as "Yours" — `page_tools.js` is not named, yet the diff adds a new `node_at()` helper, changes `complete_calls()`'s signature and recursion (now threading a `trail`), adds `PROMPT_KEYS`/`Prompt`+`Question` to `task_type()`, and adds `"unread"` to `SESSION_QUERIES`. This is shared validation code every task class and every item-tool caller runs through (diff.patch:388-402). CLAUDE.md's "Ask before… major surgery" and the task's own fence both point the same way: either the fence should have named this file, or requirements.md should say why it had to go outside it. Nothing in the task's six numbered proofs mentions this file.

The exact mechanism that makes a Question's `{complete:{}}` work live — `node_at()` walking the target/trail in `page_tools.js` to find the Question instance so `Question.completion_problem(args, node)` sees its `answer` — has no end-to-end test. `Servex/agents/page_tools.test.mjs` (33 checks, all passing) has no Question coverage at all; `Question.test.mjs` only calls `Question.completion_problem` and `.complete()` directly on the class, never through `run_item_now`/`node_at`. The one file this task edited without being fenced to is also the one piece of the Question feature nothing proves actually works through the real item tool.

`core/Session/readme.md:17` still documents the known subtask types as `add({type: "Project"|"Process"|"Session", …})`. This diff registers `Prompt` and `Question` on `Session.js` (diff.patch:576-577) and teaches `task_type()` in `page_tools.js` to recognize them, but the readme line a fresh agent would read to learn "what types can a session hold" was not updated to mention either one.

`ext/Refine/readme.md:7` still reads "...beside it the live `Prompt` instance and its class card" — the very next clause in the same sentence correctly renamed the file to `PromptRun.js` ("was `Prompt.js`"), but the class name itself was missed in this one spot. Doc elsewhere in the same diff (`doc/prompt.md`, `doc/prompt-records.md`) is consistently updated to `PromptRun`.

`Servex/agents/prompt-tasks.test.mjs` output prints a line that reads as a failure at a glance: `✗ 5 a1: this task already has a subtask "build-the-session-menu"; nothing was written...`. The suite still exits 0 and reports "23 passing" (verified by running it), so this is expected refusal noise from exercising the de-dup path, not an actual failure — but the `✗` prefix in the log makes it easy to mistake for one.
